title: 2497. Maximum Star Sum of a Graph

examples.explanation: The above diagram represents the input graph. The star graph with the maximum star sum is denoted by blue. It is centered at 3 and includes its neighbors 1 and 4. It can be shown it is not possible to get a star graph with a sum greater than 16.
There is only one possible star graph, which is node 0 itself. Hence, we return -5.
